title: Recovering Bob's bit from a disjoint coordinate
statement: Let $x, y \in \{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$ be Alice's and Bob's bits in a single coordinate, and suppose they are not both $\mathrm{true}$. Then Bob's bit extracted from the disjoint coordinate assembled from $x$ and $y$ equals $y$.
hypotheses_covered: x and y are not both true
replaced: \texttt{coordinateOfBits} preserves Bob's bit when the requested pair is disjoint.
